name: dsh-voice-polish
description: VoxPolish for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): voice input with an expression coach. Record with your own mic, get the raw transcript in ~1s (sendable at once), while a fast model rewrites it into a clear, well-structured prompt in the background. Two send buttons (raw / polished), per-style rewriting, live waveform, a custom vocabulary that fixes misrecognised words, and a model picker — and it never touches the composer draft. Uses the local SenseVoice recogniser from the official voice-input bundle, so there is no extra model download.
author: molanxuan-del <2954567135@qq.com>
